column2: a broad 13th-century troop transport cog that carries soldiers from shore to shore: round clinker-built oak hull, a wide open deep waist with clear deck room for a company of soldiers standing, low plain fore and aft castles with simple wooden rails (no crenellations, no weapons), one thick mast, one large square sail plain cream off-white (house colour), a long cream pennant at the masthead, rigging lines chunky and few, painted wood and rope; chunky Warcraft III Reforged proportions; no water, no crew, not a warship.
